content: jiant also implements the option to provide command line overrides with a flag. This option makes it easy to write scripts that launch jiant experiments over a range of parameters, for example while performing grid search across hyperparameters. jiant users have successfully run large-scale experiments launching hundreds of runs on both Kubernetes and Slurm.
